name: Cavepunk
summary: A speculative aesthetic imagining cave-dwelling civilizations, blending primitive stone tools with advanced subterranean technology.
description: Cavepunk is a speculative fiction aesthetic that imagines civilizations developing within cave systems. It blends primitive stone-age elements with advanced subterranean technology, creating a unique visual language of bioluminescent lighting, carved stone architecture, and underground ecosystems. The aesthetic explores themes of isolation, adaptation, and the tension between primitive and advanced civilization.
